libraryResources.title: Livestream Video: Apostolic Governance & Five-Fold Ministry Alignment
libraryResources.author: Apostle Dr. Kendell Pierre
libraryResources.summary: Official HTEIM livestream video recording covering foundational apostolic architecture, Ephesians 4:11 five-fold alignment, and spiritual governance.
keyTakeaways: Synergy between Apostle, Prophet, Evangelist, Pastor, and Teacher
Governmental authority and building spiritual fathers
libraryResources.fullContent:
HTEIM School of Ministry Module 4: Apostolic Governance & Five-Fold Alignment
Instructor: Apostle Dr. Kendell Pierre

1. Apostolic Foundations
2. Five-Fold Ministry Mechanics
3. Spiritual Authority and Order
4. Commissioning and Global Impact.

libraryResources.author: Apostolic Faculty Team
libraryResources.summary: Classroom video recording on cultivating spiritual discernment, testing prophecy according to scripture, and prophetic assembly protocols.
keyTakeaways: Distinction between gift of prophecy and prophetic office
Testing prophecy by scripture and spiritual fruit (1 Cor 14)

HTEIM School of Ministry Module 5: Prophetic Ministry & Spiritual Discernment

1. The Operation of Prophecy

classroomMedia.title: Livestream Video: Apostolic Governance & Five-Fold Ministry Alignment
classroomMedia.speaker: Apostle Dr. Kendell Pierre
classroomMedia.description: Official HTEIM livestream recording covering the foundational apostolic mandate, Ephesians 4:11 five-fold synergy, church governance, and spiritual fathering.

classroomMedia.title: Livestream Video: Prophetic Ministry, Spiritual Discernment & Warfare
classroomMedia.speaker: Apostolic Faculty Team
classroomMedia.description: Classroom video recording on the gift vs office of prophecy, testing prophetic words according to 1 Cor 14, spiritual discernment, and assembly protocols.

classroomMedia.title: Livestream Video: Biblical Hermeneutics & Exegesis Methodologies
classroomMedia.speaker: Pastor Samuel Selkridge
classroomMedia.description: Foundational lecture on sound biblical interpretation, historical-grammatical context, avoiding eisegesis, and homiletical exegesis.

classroomMedia.title: Livestream Video: Evangelism, The Great Commission & Soul Winning
classroomMedia.speaker: Pastor Christy Arthur
classroomMedia.description: Practical soul-winning strategies, personal witnessing, overcoming objections, the Matthew 28 mandate, and follow-up discipleship.

classroomMedia.title: Livestream Video: Ministerial Ethics, Financial Integrity & Pastoral Care
classroomMedia.speaker: Apostle Gillian Selkridge
classroomMedia.description: High ethical standards for ministers, financial transparency, pastoral counseling confidentiality, handling church conflict, and servant leadership.

classroomMedia.title: Livestream Video: School of the Pastors & Expository Preaching
classroomMedia.speaker: Pastor Samuel Selkridge
classroomMedia.description: Pastoral theology, caring for the sheepfold, sermon manuscript development, expository delivery, and ministry longevity.

facultyTeachers.name: Apostle Gillian Selkridge
facultyTeachers.title: Apostle & School Director
facultyTeachers.bio: Visionary founder of Heaven Touching Earth International Ministries. Overseeing apostolic alignment, ministerial ethics, and five-fold leadership equipping across the 6 core modules.

facultyTeachers.name: Pastor Samuel Selkridge
facultyTeachers.title: Senior Pastor & Faculty Dean
facultyTeachers.bio: Senior Pastor and Dean of Faculty with decades of pastoral devotion. Teaching deep scriptural hermeneutics, flock care, and foundational Christian doctrine.

facultyTeachers.name: Pastor Gale Grant
facultyTeachers.title: Senior Instructor & Curriculum Chair
facultyTeachers.bio: Leading curriculum development and systematic theology. Specialized in biblical worldview, ministerial integrity, and structured church administration.

facultyTeachers.name: Pastor Christy Arthur
facultyTeachers.title: Lead Instructor & Student Mentor
facultyTeachers.bio: Dedicated to empowering ministers in the art of sermon preparation, spirit-led homiletics, pulpit decorum, and transformative community outreach.

facultyTeachers.name: Prophet Garod Andrews
facultyTeachers.title: Lead Instructor & Prophetic Department Head
facultyTeachers.bio: Equipping saints in spiritual discernment, prophetic protocol, intercessory prayer warfare, and operating with spiritual authority.
